items.title: NSUI sends knives, cutters to BJP leader Chalavadi Narayanaswamy’s residence over controversial remarks
points: The Karnataka unit of the National Students’ Union of India (NSUI) on Saturday sent knives and cutters to the residence of BJP leader and Leader of the Opposition in the Legislative Council Chalavadi Narayanaswamy, through online delivery platforms, in…
Several delivery executives reportedly arrived at Mr. Narayanaswamy’s residence with packages containing knives and cutters, despite the BJP leader not having placed any such orders.
NSUI State president Kirthi Ganesh subsequently released a video statement confirming that the student organisation had deliberately placed the orders as a form of protest.
The protest was reportedly triggered by remarks allegedly made by Mr. Narayanaswamy that Congress leaders should be “cut into pieces and thrown into the Arabian Sea”.
Reacting to the alleged statement, Mr. Ganesh said the NSUI had sent the items in response to the BJP leader's comments.
He also appealed to Congress and NSUI workers across the State to place similar online orders to the BJP leader's residence.

items.title: Bengaluru: Two killed after speeding vehicle hits motorcycle on Bommasandra flyover; driver flees
points: The deceased have been identified as Lingaraju, 28, and Devarajamma, 25, both natives of neighbouring villages in Sira taluk of Tumakuru district.
Lingaraju was working as a cab driver and residing in Hoskote, while Devarajamma was employed with a private company and staying at a paying guest accommodation in Electronics City.
The two, who were acquainted with each other as they hailed from neighbouring villages, had gone out on a motorcycle on Thursday (October 5) night.
They were returning at around 1 a.m. when the accident occurred.
According to the police, their motorcycle was proceeding along the Bommasandra flyover when an unidentified vehicle rammed it.
Following information about the accident, Electronics City Traffic Police rushed to the spot, conducted an inspection and shifted the bodies to St. John’s Hospital.
The driver of the vehicle allegedly fled without stopping to help the victims.
The police have registered a case and are examining CCTV footage from roads surrounding the accident spot to identify the offending vehicle and trace its driver.

items.title: PM Modi conveys Deepavali greetings, says will celebrate the festival with soldiers
points: Prime Minister Narendra Modi performs ‘aarti’ on the eve of Deepavali at Uprashtrapati Bhawan, in New Delhi on November 7, 2026.

Radhakrishnan present. | Photo Credit: ANI Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday (November 7, 2026) conveyed Deepavali greetings to the nation, saying that, like in previous years, he will celebrate the festival with the brave soldiers of the country.
In a video message posted on his social media handles, Mr. Modi said he will celebrate the festival with great enthusiasm.
He also said the whole country was being illuminated with lights on the eve of Deepavali, and added that it reflects the country's resolve against darkness.
The Prime Minister said he has been celebrating Deepavali with the brave soldiers of the country every year.
He, however, did not disclose at which military station or post he will celebrate the festival.

items.title: Youngsters should pursue classical dance alongside academics: former V-C
points: Narthanasala students felicitating former Dr. B.R.
Ambedkar University Vice-Chancellor Hanumanthu Lajapathirai in Vizianagaram on Saturday. | Photo Credit: ARRANGEMENT Dr. B.R.
Ambedkar University former Vice-Chancellor Hanumanthu Lajapathirai on Saturday said that Indian dance forms reflected the country’s rich heritage and culture.
He urged youngsters to pursue classical dance forms such as Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi alongside their academic studies.

He was speaking as the chief guest at a programme titled ‘Read to Understand and Dance to Express’, organised by Narthanasala Institute in association with the Rotary Club, Vizianagaram Reads and other organisations.

According to a press release issued by the organisers, Dr. Lajapathirai said Indian art forms were appreciated across the world as they were deeply rooted in the country’s heritage, culture and epics such as the Ramayana and the Mahabharata.

Narthanasala Dance Institute founder Radhika Rani and Vizianagaram Reads founder Eswar Repalle said Vizianagaram had produced several eminent dancers who had brought laurels to the city through their performances in other States and abroad.

items.title: Assam OIL facility fire death toll rises to three
points: Tapas Gogoi, working for a Mumbai-based private agency engaged by the oil exploration major, succumbed to his injuries at a private hospital in Dibrugarh town at around 3 a.m.
Another worker, Rupam Gogoi, died at a private hospital in Guwahati at around 11 a.m., taking the death toll in the fire incident to three.
He was shifted from the Assam Medical College and Hospital in Dibrugarh for advanced treatment.
The third person, identified as Raju Dutta, died from the impact of the explosion on Friday (November 6, 2026) morning.

The bath heater was isolated on November 4 for maintenance.

items.title: Adani Ports Agrees €2.56 Billion Deal For Europe’s Second-Largest Liquid Storage Operator
points: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd (APSEZ) will acquire the Netherlands-based liquid storage operator Evos B.V. for an enterprise value of €2.56 billion, giving it eight port-based terminals across Europe.
The company would buy a 100% stake from Igneo Infrastructure Partners in an all-cash transaction, APSEZ said.
APSEZ describes Evos as the second biggest independent player in liquid storage in Europe, with tanks holding 6.3 million cubic metres in total.

The terminals are spread over the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Belgium and Malta, with a presence in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp (ARA) cluster, Hamburg and the Mediterranean, all of them energy and industrial centres.
Across the sites, there are 452 tanks and 63 berths for ships and barges, while pipelines connect them to Schiphol Airport and the Central Europe Pipeline System.
In 2025, the terminals moved 37 million metric tonnes (MMT) of product.

items.title: One Of The World’s Largest Warships Docks In Singapore On Way To The Middle East
points: The U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived in Singapore on Friday with its strike group for a port visit, before heading to the Middle East.
The visit was first reported by USNI News, which said that the group includes a cruiser and two destroyers apart from the carrier.
The Nimitz-class carrier is among the largest warships in the world.
Two of the escorts docked at Changi Naval Base, while the third escort berthed at Sembawang.
Once the port call ends, the strike group is expected to sail through the Malacca Strait, which connects the South China Sea to the Indian Ocean.
The Roosevelt is expected to relieve the USS George Washington carrier strike group, which has been operating in the Middle East since August 19.
It left San Diego quietly in late September and first went to the Western Pacific, where it exercised with Japanese naval forces in the Philippine Sea and South China Sea last week.

items.title: Indian Navy Adds Fifth Of 8 Shallow Water Anti-Submarine Warship With Over 80% Indigenous Content
points: INS Amini, the latest anti-submarine warfare shallow water craft (ASW SWC) from Garden Reach Shipbuilders and Engineers (GRSE), has joined the Indian Navy after a handover at Kattupalli in Tamil Nadu on November 5, 2026.
The warship is the fifth of the eight ASW SWCs being built by the Kolkata-based shipyard for the Indian Navy.

The Indian Navy announced the delivery in a post on the social media platform X, while the Ministry of Defence said that the vessel would strengthen the Navy’s anti-submarine, coastal surveillance and mine-laying capabilities.
According to reports, Amini measures about 77.6 metres in length and has a shallow draught of around 2.7 metres.
Additionally, it has a 30 mm naval gun and a Combat Management System.
Construction followed the Indian Register of Shipping classification rules, and more than 80% of the vessel is made in India.
The vessel has been named after Amini Island in Lakshadweep and it was launched on November 16, 2023.

items.title: Seaspan Places Record-Breaking Canadian Steel Order To Build Canada’s Next Generation Of Icebreakers
points: Seaspan Shipyards (Seaspan) has announced the award of Algoma Steel Inc. (Algoma) and Stigterstaal Canada (Stigterstaal) as the primary steel plate supplier for up to six multi-purpose icebreakers (MPI) for the Canadian Coast Guard (CCG).

The new agreement, valued at about $182 million, establishes the supply of up to 24,000 metric tonnes of Canadian-made structural steel — 4,000 metric tonnes of steel plate per vessel — to support Seaspan’s construction of the CCG’s MPI vessels under…

This agreement is the result of strong collaboration between Seaspan, Algoma and Stigterstaal, building upon the companies’ strategic partnership established in 2025 to further strengthen Canada’s domestic steel and marine manufacturing industries.
Designed in Canada by Seaspan’s world-class icebreaker design team, the Canadian Coast Guard’s multi-purpose icebreakers will operate in Canada’s Lower Arctic and offshore environments.

Measuring approximately 100 metres in length with a displacement of nearly 9,000 tonnes, the ships will accommodate a crew of 50 personnel and feature advanced diesel-electric propulsion with Polar Class 4 (PC4) icebreaking capability.

items.title: Diwali 2026 Muhurat trading: Why do NSE, BSE break the holiday rule for special live trading session? Explained
points: India’s stock markets will open for a special shortened session on Sunday as the country celebrates Diwali, its biggest festival, keeping alive a tradition that has survived the shift from handwritten ledgers and bustling trading floors to smartphones and…
Known as Muhurat trading, the ceremonial session marks the start of a new Hindu calendar year, called Samvat, for many of India’s trading communities.

While a recent rebound has turned India into a relative bright spot amid the global tech selloff, equity benchmarks are ending Samvat 2082 down more than 3%, their worst annual performance in over a decade.
Here’s what to know about one of the most enduring traditions of the Indian stock market: Muhurat trading is a special stock market session held on Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights.
A pre-open session will run from 2:05 p.m. to 2:20 p.m., followed by trading from 2:20 p.m. to 3:30 p.m.
The traditional business year is separate from India’s official financial year, which runs from April 1 through March 31.

items.title: High fares, longer journeys, delays make special trains less attractive to passengers: Officials
points: New Delhi, Despite the Railway Ministry's claim of operating 18,000 special train trips across the country to clear the festive rush, regular trains continue to be in much greater demand, with waiting lists often exceeding the permissible limit and…

Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said on Saturday during a media interaction that all trains were being monitored closely through a special War Room set up at Rail Bhawan to ensure their safe and timely arrival at destinations.
"If you look at the New Delhi-Patna route, Train No. 04096, a festival special, charges ₹1,745 for an AC 3-tier ticket, whereas the regular Sampoorna Kranti Express charges ₹1,390," an official said.
While it takes 22 hours and 55 minutes, the Sampoorna Kranti Express completes the journey in 13 hours and 8 minutes.
"Despite the longer scheduled journey time, special trains hardly reach their destinations on time, often resulting in a tiring journey of 25 to 30 hours," he said.

items.title: ONGC shares: Venezuela oil project hopes lift focus after Q2 results | Should you buy? Key levels to watch
points: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) shares will remain in focus after the company's finance head, Anupam Agarwal, said it expects to secure operatorship rights for two Venezuelan oil projects within the next three to six months.
The development comes ahead of the special one-hour Diwali Muhurat Trading session on Sunday, 8 November, marking the beginning of the new Hindu financial year, Samvat 2083.

According to the Reuters report, ONGC Videsh, the overseas investment arm of ONGC, has more than $500 million in pending dividends from its stakes in two Venezuelan projects — the San Cristobal oilfield and the Carabobo 1 field.
Agarwal said ONGC expects to secure full operatorship of the San Cristobal project, in which it holds a 40% stake, while Venezuelan state-owned oil company PDVSA owns the remaining interest.
ONGC and other Indian companies collectively hold an 18% stake in the Carabobo project, while Spain's Repsol owns an 11% interest.

points: A senior tech business executive who had flown home from Singapore for his nephew's wedding was shot dead by his neighbour on Friday night in Haryana's Faridabad, after a row over a parked car outside their shared building escalated into gunfire.
The neighbour allegedly fired around 15 rounds from his licensed pistol, hitting him nine times, police said.
The victim, Paramjit Dhankhar, who'd headed Indian IT major Tech Mahindra's Asia operations and reportedly worked for a Vietnam-based company at present, died on the spot, police said.

items.title: Uttar Pradesh government hikes DA by 3% for employees
points: The Uttar Pradesh government has hiked the Dearness Allowance (DA) by 3% for State government employees, staff in aided educational and technical institutions, regular and full-time employees of urban local bodies, work-charged employees, and those serving…
Employees will now receive a Dearness Allowance of 63%, up from 60%.
The increased rate will be effective from July 1, 2026, the State government said in a statement on Saturday (November 7, 2026).
A Government Order was also issued in this regard on Saturday.
The enhanced Dearness Allowance will be paid along with the regular salary for November 2026.
This government decision will benefit lakhs of employees across the State.

points: A UPSC aspirant, who had tried his luck on the game show 'Kaun Banega Crorepati', was arrested in Delhi after a year on the run for stealing a gold chain from a Mumbai jewellery shop.
Satish Kumar Krishnaprasad Kesari, a resident of Delhi's Uttam Nagar, had big dreams when he came to Delhi in search of a job, but eventually struggled to pay off his debts.
Originally from Bihar, the 42-year-old computer science graduate wanted to become an IAS officer.
He worked towards his goal and prepared for the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) examinations while working part-time, but his attempts went in vain.
He then tried to win cash prizes at the popular game show 'Kaun Banega Crorepati', but could not get past the qualifying stage titled 'Fastest Finger First'.

He Wanted To Prank Ex-Roommate Putting this plan into action on November 15 last year, the UPSC aspirant stole a gold chain weighing 43.2 grams from Padmavati Jewellers, located on Mathuradas Road in Mumbai's Kandivali West.

items.title: PM Modi extends Diwali greeting to nation: ‘festival of light reflects our resolve against darkness’
points: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday extended Diwali greetings to the nation through a video message, highlighting the festival as a symbol of light’s triumph over darkness and expressing hope for happiness, peace and prosperity for all citizens.
He also said he would continue his tradition of celebrating Diwali with the Indian soldiers, without disclosing where he plans to spend the festival this year.
In a 50-second video message shared on social media platforms including X, Modi appeared in traditional attire with a tilak and addressed people directly, extending his greetings on the festival.
PM Modi’s annual visits to military locations on Diwali have become a consistent feature of his tenure since 2014.

In subsequent years, he marked the festival with troops in the Punjab sector near Amritsar in 2015, Sumdoh near the China border in Himachal Pradesh in 2016, the Gurez sector in Jammu and Kashmir in 2017, and Harsil in Uttarakhand in 2018.

items.title: Indian Army debunks ‘unsubstantiated, false’ claims of Chinese troops advancing in Arunachal Pradesh

points: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Friday said the state government will bring to the notice of the Supreme Court and Gauhati High Court threats by a group to gherao his residence if bail is granted to two prime accused in the Zubeen Garg death case.
Speaking to reporters, Sarma said the threat given by a group led by a legislator poses a "danger to my family and could amount to a direct attempt to murder".
The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear the bail petitions of prime accused Shyamkanu Mahanta and Siddhartha Sharma on November 30.
The Gauhati High Court granted bail to singer Amritprava Mahanta, an accused in the Zubeen Garg death case, on October 9 against a bond of Rs 50,000 and two sureties of the same amount.

items.title: Tripura Police Question Suspected Illegal Entrants Days After Attack On BSF
points: Days after an attack on BSF personnel at Ashabari, security agencies in Tripura have stepped up checks along the India-Bangladesh border, with several people suspected of having entered India illegally taken to a local police station for questioning and…

The questioning comes amid a wider verification drive in Sepahijala district, where teams comprising the Border Security Force (BSF), Tripura Police and Revenue Department officials have begun checking land records and properties in villages along the border.
During the inspections, officials are visiting houses and commercial establishments, asking occupants to produce land ownership documents, including pattas.
Officials have found suspected instances of construction on government land during the preliminary checks.
The exercise follows a security review chaired by Chief Minister Dr Manik Saha after the November 2 attack.
Meanwhile, the number of arrests in connection with the Ashabari attack has reached 18.

items.title: From Diwali 2025 to Diwali 2026: How Sensex, Nifty 50, rupee, crude oil changed in Samvat 2082 | What lies ahead?
points: Samvat 2082 was a year of divergence across global and domestic financial markets, with Indian equities lagging several major international benchmarks even as commodities rallied sharply and the rupee weakened against the US dollar.
The Nifty 50 declined 2.59% and the Sensex fell 3.35% between Diwali 2025 and Diwali 2026, while the Nifty Midcap 150 and Nifty Smallcap 250 managed modest gains of 0.90% and 0.29%, respectively.
In contrast, Japan's Nikkei surged 13.08%, South Korea's KOSPI jumped 23.63% and the FTSE advanced 11.26%, reflecting stronger gains across major global markets.
Pharma and metal stocks led the rally, with the Nifty Pharma rising 24.77% and Nifty Metal gaining 21.71%, while FMCG, IT and realty stocks weighed on the market.
At the individual stock level, BSE emerged as the top Nifty 50 performer with a 52.3% gain, whereas ITC plunged 30.94%, making it the biggest laggard.
Adding to the pressure, the Indian rupee depreciated around 7.1% against the US dollar, with the exchange rate moving from approximately ₹87.90 to ₹94.14.

items.title: Vijayan questions CM over power purchase deal, seeks release of files
points: Thiruvananthapuram, Leader of Opposition Pinarayi Vijayan on Saturday accused Chief Minister V D Satheesan of creating confusion over the controversial power purchase deal with the GNA platform and demanded that all related files be made public.

In a statement, Vijayan said the chief minister was trying to evade serious allegations instead of providing clarity on the deal and asked why the government was reluctant to release the complete files and correspondence related to it.

items.title: Expensive EVs Do Not Make Financial Sense - Here Is Why
points: They believed that EVs make a lot of financial sense.
Expensive, performance-focussed EVs (like the Tesla Model Y for example) make little financial sense in the Indian context.
Models like the Tesla Model Y have ex-showroom prices of around 62 lakh rupees.
In the mass-market segment, a lower end product may cost around Rs 7 lakh, whereas a larger, higher-segment offering may cost Rs 14.85 lakh, ex-showroom.
The upper end of the segment has EVs like the Mahindra XEV 9e, the top variants of which cost around Rs 31.25 lakh..
However, for more expensive electric cars which cost around Rs 20 lakh, the recovery process becomes difficult and takes much more time.
A Tata Sierra.EV that has an ex-showroom price of around Rs 22.74 lakh, has over 360 Bhp of power on offer.
300+ Bhp is well inside the performance territory.

Returning from a North America roadshow that included meetings with sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, endowments and family offices, Shah said India remains firmly on the radar of global capital.

Shah described India as a “structural bull market available at a cyclical valuation discount,” arguing that investors can today access India’s long-term growth story at far more reasonable valuations than during the market’s peak exuberance.

items.title: Congress pushing Telangana towards ‘Asset bankruptcy’, alleges BJP leader Gudur
points: Congress government is pushing Telangana towards “asset bankruptcy” by relying on auctions of valuable government lands to meet its immediate revenue requirements, alleged senior BJP leader Gudur Narayana Reddy.
Citing CAG-related figures, Mr. Narayana Reddy said Telangana received ₹16,478 crore from land, property, and miscellaneous sources in 2023-24, accounting for about 69% of its non-tax revenue.
He said the erstwhile TSIIC had 53,473.76 acres as of March 31, 2022, and had made 2,355 land allotments covering around 4,050 acres between 2014-15 and 2021-22.

He pointed out that the BRS government had auctioned about 31 acres in the Raidurg-Knowledge City corridor for nearly ₹730 crore, while land prices at Kokapet Neopolis had touched ₹100.75 crore per acre in August 2023.

items.title: Under-construction roof of school auditorium collapses in Keralam; no casualties
points: Updated - November 07, 2026 04:12 pm IST - Thiruvananthapuram An under-construction roof of an auditorium at an aided school in Keralam collapsed on Saturday (November 7, 2026).
However, no one was injured, officials said.
The incident occurred around noon at PKS Higher Secondary School, Kanjiramkulam, near Neyyattinkara, Education department officials said.
The auditorium had a tin-sheet roof, and work was underway to replace it with a concrete structure.
The roofing work was carried out on Friday, but heavy rain later affected the structure, officials said.
The entire concrete roof structure, including the steel bars and supporting poles, collapsed, they said.
The workers present at the site managed to move to safety after noticing the roof collapsing, officials said.
Work has begun to clear the debris, and Public Works Department officials will examine whether any defects in the construction work led to the collapse, officials added.

points: Of the 85 inmates, 70 have expressed willingness to enrol for SSC and 15 for Intermediate courses for the current academic year.

It will allow inmates to resume their education through TOSS, with study materials, academic support and regular classes on Sundays and second Saturdays.
Classes can also be conducted on other days depending on the requirements of the Prisons Department.

items.title: Coca-Cola’s Indian bottling arm HCCH files IPO papers; entire issue to be OFS
points: The proposed IPO will be entirely an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 99.75 crore equity shares by promoter Hindustan Coca-Cola Overseas Holdings Pte Ltd, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) dated November 6.
The filing comes months after Coca-Cola in June said it was exploring a potential listing of HCCH, the parent entity of its Indian bottling arm Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages (HCCB) in 2027.
According to the TKC Report cited in the DRHP, HCCH was the largest non-alcoholic ready-to-drink (NARTD) beverage company by revenue operating exclusively in India in FY26.
For the three-month period ended June 30, 2026, the company’s retained units reported revenue from operations of ₹4,310.17 crore, registering a year-on-year growth of 20.46 per cent.

In terms of ownership, The Coca-Cola Company, through Hindustan Coca-Cola Overseas Holdings Pte Ltd, held a 60 per cent stake in HCCH as of the DRHP filing date, while Jubilant Beverages Ltd owned the remaining 40 per cent.

items.title: After "Vote Chori" Claim, Rahul Gandhi Points To Alleged "Petrol Chori"
points: After weeks of protests over, what he calls, "vote chori", Rahul Gandhi on Saturday alleged that the government is "stealing petrol" from the public's cars and criticised the government's rollout of ethanol-blended (E20) petrol.
Gandhi said the government claims that the petrol contains 20 per cent ethanol but tests conducted on samples collected from seven districts in Congress-ruled Karnataka had revealed higher levels.
In a post in Hindi on X, Gandhi said, "E20 turned into 420 - stealing petrol from the public's cars!" The reference was to Section 420 of the erstwhile Indian Penal Code, which dealt with cheating.

points: The Indian Army has strongly refuted false reports on social media suggesting that Chinese forces made significant territorial gains in Arunachal Pradesh.
Claims of a 50 km advance in early November were thoroughly investigated, revealing six accounts deliberately pushing misleading information.
Official sources assure that there has been no major defeat of Indian troops, emphasizing the importance of relying on credible sources for updates on border issues to combat misinformation.

points: A mural of Rabindranath Tagore was vandalized in Khulna, where opposing posters were also displayed nearby.
Local officials and cultural activists have since condemned the act, arguing it reflects narrow-mindedness.

The controversy raises concerns about the treatment and recognition of cultural icons in Bangladesh.

items.title: Akhilesh, Dimple Yadav to visit Ram Temple in Ayodhya on Dec 12, says SP leader Pandey ahead of UP polls
points: Akhilesh Yadav and Dimple Yadav are set to tour the Ram Temple and Hanumangarhi in Ayodhya on December 12, marking Akhilesh's first visit since the temple's grand opening in January 2024.
This visit aligns with the BJP-led Deepotsav festivities, intensifying the political dynamics in Ayodhya as the 2027 elections approach.
Akhilesh had promised a visit following the completion of Kedareshwar Dham in Etawah.

points: In a recent statement, Sonia Gandhi discussed the hurdles facing the Congress party under the ruling BJP government, particularly the compromising of the Election Commission's independence, which she believes undermines fair elections.
